categories.main_business_segments: Nanjing Hanrui Cobalt Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of cobalt metal powder, cobalt hydroxide, electrolytic cobalt, electrolytic copper, and other cobalt and copper products. The company operates a complete cobalt industry chain from raw material mining, acquisition, processing, smelting to intermediate products and cobalt powder production. It also has business in nickel resources and new energy materials, including lithium cobalt oxide and battery materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes wet smelting processes for cobalt and copper products, advanced powder metallurgy technologies for cobalt powder production, and continuous oxygen-enriched blowing refining for high-grade nickel production. It emphasizes R&D in cobalt powder morphology, purity, and particle size control, and has developed proprietary technologies such as high-voltage lithium cobalt oxide materials and sodium-ion battery cathode materials. The company also applies automated production lines and process innovations to improve product quality and operational efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading enterprises in hard alloy manufacturing, aerospace, electronics, automotive, and battery industries. The company serves global markets with sales networks in Japan, South Korea, Switzerland, Israel, India, and the United States. Its cobalt products are widely used in high-temperature alloys, hard alloys, diamond tools, magnetic materials, and corrosion-resistant materials, while copper products serve electrical, electronic, and mechanical manufacturing sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Nanjing and production bases in Anhui, Jiangxi, and other provinces. It has overseas subsidiaries and operations in the Democratic Republic of Congo (mining and initial processing), Indonesia (nickel projects), Hong Kong, and Singapore (sales and trading). The company’s products are sold domestically and internationally, covering major cobalt and copper consuming regions globally.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nanjing Hanrui Cobalt occupies an upstream to midstream position in the cobalt and copper supply chain, including mining, acquisition of raw ores, smelting, refining, and production of intermediate and finished cobalt and copper products. It also extends downstream into battery material production and new energy materials, integrating resource development with high-value-added processing and sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation in cobalt powder production, battery materials, and nickel refining. R&D focuses include ultra-coarse and ultra-fine cobalt powder production, impurity reduction, new cathode materials for lithium and sodium-ion batteries, and environmentally friendly processing techniques. It aims to enhance product quality, expand product categories, and develop new energy material solutions to support the electric vehicle and electronics markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the direct sale of cobalt powders, cobalt salts, electrolytic cobalt, electrolytic copper, and battery materials. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by distributors, with pricing linked to international metal market benchmarks such as the London Metal Exchange and Metal Bulletin cobalt prices. It also derives income from investment returns and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Nanjing Hanrui Cobalt is one of the top three global cobalt powder suppliers, recognized for its strong R&D capabilities and complete cobalt industry chain. While it has a smaller asset and production scale compared to international large cobalt producers, it maintains competitive advantages through stable raw material supply from Congo, technological innovation, and strategic resource expansion in nickel and lithium sectors. The company faces competition from major global cobalt and copper producers but leverages its integrated supply chain and customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 5.95 billion, a 24.25% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 201.6 million, up 45.85%. Total assets reached RMB 8.63 billion, growing 11% from the previous year. The company’s cash flow from operations significantly improved, reflecting enhanced sales and operational efficiency. It continues to invest in capacity expansion and new projects, indicating a growth trajectory supported by industry demand recovery and strategic resource development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality cobalt powder with uniform morphology, particle size, purity, and low oxygen content tailored to diverse customer needs. Its complete cobalt industry chain ensures stable, low-cost raw material supply and product consistency. Technological leadership in cobalt powder production and battery material innovation, combined with strong global brand recognition and strategic resource integration, differentiates it as a reliable supplier in the cobalt and new energy materials market.
